title: 楔子必须当官
content_zh:
刘飞站在学校宿舍的窗前，狠狠地吸了一口烟，望着窗外闪烁的霓虹灯，他的目光中闪烁着坚毅的神色。

就在刚刚，一个神秘的男人找上了他，这个人是来给刘飞送信的。

刘飞看完信后才知道，自己一直苦苦寻找的父母竟然还尚在人世，只是因为某种原因不能相认罢了。

得知这个消息，刘飞又喜又恨，他恨父母为何会抛弃他，尤其是那神秘的男人最后说的话让刘飞非常愤怒：“要想和父母见面除非你的官职升到副厅级！如果你是个废物，我可以帮你一步一步的升到副厅级，如果你是强者，你就自己去打拼，遇到任何困难都可以来找我。”

“我是强者，我要自己去打拼，我要当面去问问他们为什么把我像狗一样扔下不管……”刘飞歇斯底里的吼道。

神秘男人一笑，悄然离去。窗外，夜色朦胧，苍穹幽暗，唯有屋中刘飞的怒火在熊熊的燃烧，斗志如同潮水一般，汹涌澎湃，一个声音在他的心底大声的呐喊：“我要当官！我要去考公务员！”
content_en:
Liu Fei stood in front of the window of the school dormitory, took a long drag on his cigarette, and looked at the flashing neon lights outside the window, his eyes flashing with perseverance.

Just now, a mysterious man came to him. This man came to deliver a message to Liu Fei.

After reading the letter, Liu Fei realized that the parents he had been searching for were still alive, but they could not recognize each other for some reason.

After hearing the news, Liu Fei felt both joy and hatred. He hated why his parents abandoned him, especially what the mysterious man said at the end made Liu Fei very angry: "If you want to meet your parents, your official position must be promoted to the deputy department level! If you are a waste, I can help you rise to the deputy department level step by step. If you are strong, you can work hard on your own. If you encounter any difficulties, you can come to me."

"I am a strong person. I want to fight on my own. I want to ask them face to face why they abandoned me like a dog..." Liu Fei roared hysterically.

The mysterious man smiled and left quietly. Outside the window, the night was hazy and the sky was dark. Only Liu Fei's anger was burning in the room. His fighting spirit was surging like a tide. A voice shouted loudly in his heart: "I want to be an official! I want to take the civil service exam!"
